paragraphs.text: The Daru Plains sprawl across the southern edge of the Otarian continent on Dominaria .

These plains are home to a culture of nomadic humans . The Order is made up of many of these tribesfolk, and is an important force throughout the continent. It rules the plains as the de facto government. Though they are wanderers, the Daru nomads have built a fortification in the area as a power center where the highest officer resides. Their clerics fashion robes and 'armor' from the long grass of the Daru Plains.
